name: elagoht/session
description: A collage plugin for a session kept in a cookie: a small map of strings the site signs, and can encrypt, with no database behind it.
setup:
In an action: `session.Get(rc).Set(session.UserKey, user.ID)`, then redirect; in a data handler: `session.Get(rc).Get(session.UserKey)`.
To keep a layout's pages for signed-in readers: `.WithGuard(session.RequireUser("/login"))` on the layout's fragment.
Set `"keyEnv": "SESSION_KEY"` in `plugins-config.json`, and `SESSION_KEY=` (`openssl rand -hex 32`) in `.env.development` and where production runs; without a key a restart signs everyone out.

config.description: A collage plugin for a session kept in a cookie: a small map of strings the site signs, and can encrypt, with no database behind it.

cookie.description: Cookie is the cookie's name. Default "collage_session".

domain.description: Domain is the cookie's domain. Default none: the host that set it.

encrypt.description: Encrypt encrypts the session with AES-GCM, so the reader cannot read what it holds. Without it the session is only signed: the reader can read it, and cannot change it.

idleTimeout.description: IdleTimeout is how long without a request ends a session: "30m". Default 0, no idle limit. With one, the cookie is rewritten as the reader keeps coming back, at most every quarter of the timeout. Whole seconds, rounded down: at least "1s" when set.

keyEnv.description: KeyEnv names the environment variable holding the key, hex-encoded. When set, it wins over Key, and an unset, empty or non-hex variable is an error.

maxAge.description: MaxAge is how long a session lives from when it was started or regenerated, however active its reader: "168h". Default a week. Counted in whole seconds, rounded down, as the cookie's Max-Age is, so it is at least "1s".

path.description: Path is the cookie's path. Default "/".

previousKeysEnv.description: PreviousKeysEnv names the environment variable holding the previous keys, hex-encoded and comma-separated. When set, it wins over PreviousKeys; a variable that is not set, or a key in it that is not hex, is an error, and one set but empty is no previous keys.

sameSite.description: SameSite is "lax" (the default), "strict" or "none". "none" needs Secure.

secure.description: Secure sends the cookie over HTTPS only, always. Without it the cookie is Secure when the request arrived over TLS, or through a proxy that says so with X-Forwarded-Proto: https (collage.IsHTTPS: one listed in Server.TrustedProxies when any are).
